messages:
PagerDuty Bot: PagerDuty alert triggered: multiple 503s observed from region eu-west-1 against dedicated serving pool 'pool-d-eu'. Incident ID INC-2026-03-12-42. Severity: P2. Auto-retries suppressed.
Maya Patel: acknowledging, I'm primary for the shift and grabbing the bridge. will start triage.
Raj Singh: standing by as secondary. ping me if we need capacity or customer comms.
Maya Patel: quick TL;DR from initial checks — a rollout to pool-d-eu at ~02:10 UTC left 3 nodes with GPU driver/kernel mismatch. nodes started throwing NVML OOM errors and k8s evictions. traffic began failing over to fallback which is slower -> 503s and p95 increase.
Olivia Chen: pulling node metrics and kube events now. preliminary: memory spike on node-18 at 02:12, then node-17 and node-19 show similar telemetry.
Olivia Chen: command: `kubectl get nodes -o wide | grep pool-d-eu` -> node-17 Ready, node-18 NotReady, node-19 Ready(tainted). seeing `kernel-module: mismatch` in syslogs.
Maya Patel: disabling further rollouts to pool-d-eu (paused in Deployment) and raising autoscaler min to keep capacity. runbook referenced: https://confluence.internal.redwood/ops/serve-pool-failover (ops/serve-pool-failover).
Kai Leonard: I pushed a router policy to divert new sessions to pool-d-eu-fallback at 02:28 UTC. that cut the error rate sharply. traffic now goes to fallback with higher latency, so customers are degraded but not fully impacted.
Maya Patel: after reroute, 503s down ~85% but backend p95 on fallback is ~2.1s. still above SLO.
Raj Singh: contacting top affected customers and opening tickets (RD-4523, RD-4524, RD-4525). sales/CS notified.
PagerDuty Bot: Note: 2 similar alerts auto-deduped in the last 10m.
Olivia Chen: deeper logs show `nvml: out of memory` on node-18 followed by kubelet OOM kill events. plan: cordon+drain node-18 and reprovision.
Maya Patel: proceeding with cordon+drain: `kubectl cordon node-18 && kubectl drain node-18 --ignore-daemonsets --delete-local-data` — will respect PDBs.
Olivia Chen: cordon complete; drain started. pods rescheduled to fallback pools.
Kai Leonard: kicked infra reprovision job: `infra create-node --region eu-west --gpu a100 --pool pool-d-eu` -> job #8492. ETA ~7-12m.
Maya Patel: handoff note: I will remain primary for the next hour. Raj will take primary at 03:30 UTC. Secondary remains Raj, backup is Kai. document handoff in this thread before I leave.
Raj Singh: I'll be ready for 03:30. open actions for next shift: monitor job #8492, confirm node replacement applied and kube readiness, verify 503 rate returns to baseline, validate no further rollouts to pool-d-eu.
Maya Patel: post-incident checklist started. items: capture deploy diff (git sha), kernel module version, node telemetry, autoscaler config snapshot, router policy change (audit). created incident doc: https://confluence.internal.redwood/incident/INC-2026-03-12-42
Olivia Chen: current metrics: 503 rate ~2% (baseline 0.1%), p95 on fallback 2.1s -> improved but not normal. replacement node provisioning in progress. next step: run stress test on pool-d-eu once new node joins; if reprovision fails we'll roll kernel version back on reprovisioned images.
Maya Patel: coverage note for ops leads: EU night window has one designated oncall tomorrow 02:00-08:00; recommend +1 additional volunteer for next week to avoid single point-of-failure during rollouts. tagging @ops-leads for coordination.
Raj Singh: ack. I'll prepare a concise handoff doc with commands to run if spike recurs and paste here before 03:30.
Maya Patel: closing the active bridge for now — leaving the channel open for updates. Handoff summary pinned to this thread. :thumbsup:
